note: The gate on draft 2. Two majors (20:11, 20:13) and one minor (20:14). «A tradução é geralmente adequada ao latim, mas substitui uma imagem por sua interpretação e resolve uma construção deliberadamente insólita.»

outcomes.remark: MAJOR: 'descendência' makes explicit the referent of the image of seed, which the Latin keeps in parallel with 'fruto' → 'a sua semente'
outcomes.reason: The glossary row semen → descendência is open and names this verse; here the fruit is kept and the seed answers it (D2). The second colon ('dentre os filhos dos homens') tells the ear the seed is offspring. The row's general ruling stays for Gustavo.

outcomes.remark: MAJOR again: dorsum is the predicate of eos; 'ficar de costas' adds a verb and makes a posture → 'fareis deles um dorso'
outcomes.reason: Taken in substance: the predicate noun, no added verb, in the glossary build for pónere + predicate (fazer de X Y, 17:12) — 'fareis deles costas' — with the Portuguese word for a man's back ('dorso' is an animal's or a book's). 'ficar de costas' and his 'um dorso' are options.

outcomes.remark: minor: Exaltáre is passive; the reflexive may make the Lord exalt himself → 'Sede exaltado'
outcomes.reason: He grants the middle reading; the glossary row Exaltáre → exaltai-vos serves the formula wherever it opens a verse (7:7a, 56:6, 56:12, 93:2, 107:6); 'Sede exaltado' is a stiff passive. Kept as option 3.

note: v3. Two verses changed: 20:11 'e a sua semente dentre os filhos dos homens'; 20:13 'Porque fareis deles costas' (both the Latinist's majors at the gate). Draft 2 is prayed.v2.json (flat text prayed.v2.vos.json). Script: ps020/revise_v3.py; ps020/validate.py passes.

Draft 3: hard pass. Soft flags accepted: 20:3 −3 / −3; 20:4 first colon −3; 20:5 −5; 20:9 first colon +3; 20:12 second colon −5; 20:14 second colon +6 (D25's two words and the plural). 20:11 and 20:13 are no longer flagged.

The gate on draft 3: clean of majors — two minors, both D27. «A tradução conserva o conteúdo latino, inclusive suas imagens e construções incomuns; as ressalvas dizem respeito ao número na fórmula de perpetuidade.»
